subject: Billing Ops: request to add billing specialist (IC4) + offer plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Billing Ops: request to add billing specialist (IC4) + offer plan

Hi Laura and Vivek,

Following up from our RevOps sync — we're seeing a sustained backlog in billing reconciliations and invoice exceptions that is impacting month-end close. Hiring a dedicated Billing Specialist (IC4) would:
- Offload recurring invoice exception work from the CS/Billing on-call rota
- Reduce manual adjustments and write-offs (estimated $45–60k annual saving from reduced leakage)
- Improve SLA for invoice resolution (current median 7 days -> target 2 days)

Ask: approval to open 1 FTE headcount for Billing Ops (IC4, team-coded under RevOps / Billing Ops). Proposed comp: base band midpoint $115,000, offer range $105k–125k depending on experience. Total first-year loaded cost (salary + benefits + ramp) ~ $150k.

Attachments: comp-band-model-v3.xlsx (banding and cost math), candidate_SGreen_profile.pdf (early-stage candidate the recruiter has screened).

If approved, I want to extend an offer this week to the candidate from TalentProsourcing (Samantha Green) — she hits the must-have technical checklist and has prior billing system (Zuora) experience. Draft offer uses the standard offer-template-redwood.docx with signing by People Ops.

Next steps I propose:
1) Laura — quick signoff on the loaded cost and band alignment so FP&A can mark budget.
2) Vivek — confirm headcount/priority vs other RevOps requests (this will sit on the billing ops pod).
3) If both green, I'll ask TalentPros to issue verbal and then send formal offer via Greenhouse.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of RevOps (interim)
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing Ops: request to add billing specialist (IC4) + offer plan

Karthik — thanks for the clear ask and the spreadsheet. I reviewed comp-band-model-v3.xlsx and the math looks reasonable. A few notes: 
- FP&A can accommodate the $150k loaded cost in Q3 hiring plan by reassigning the vacant budget line from one delayed marketing contractor. I'll mark this in the hiring tracker.
- Please keep the offer within the $105k–125k band. If you go above midpoint, we need a short justification (unique skill set / critical market hire).
- We need the hiring manager to confirm the current year headcount delta (for the org chart and forecast).

If you confirm that the role will replace (not net new) an open contractor, I can approve immediately. Otherwise, I need a one-line justification for the net-new headcount to carry into the quarterly forecast.

Approve-in-principle from FP&A pending your confirmation on replacement vs net-new.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, FP&A
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing Ops: request to add billing specialist (IC4) + offer plan

Adding a quick operational perspective:
- We are +1 slot for billing ops in headcount prioritization, but we currently have two other near-term asks (payments engineer and a reporting analyst). If this hire materially reduces write-offs, it gets priority.
- Confirm that the role reports into Billing Ops (not CS) and that onboarding includes 2 weeks shadow on Zuora and 1 week cross-team handoff with CS.

Also, before we extend an offer, let's align to the comp band philosophy: we should avoid top-of-band offers unless the candidate has >5 years relevant billing ops experience or specialized Zuora migrations. If you believe Samantha qualifies for top-of-band, please call out the 2–3 specific items that justify it.

If you want me to escalate the priority, say the word and I'll move it up. Otherwise, proceed after Laura confirms replacement/net-new.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: TalentProsourcing <recruits@talentpros.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Billing Ops: request to add billing specialist (IC4) + offer plan

Hi all — quick update from the candidate side.

Samantha Green (candidate) — verbal availability: can start 4 weeks from verbal accept. Comp expectations shared: base target $120k, open to $115k–$125k depending on total comp structure. She has 6 years experience (3 years running Zuora-only billing queue workflows), two references on enterprise billing migrations.

Attachment: candidate_SGreen_profile.pdf (resume + recruiter notes).

If you can approve band midpoint at $120k we can move to verbal and get an accepted headcount commitment this week. We can also prepare the Greenhouse offer URL once you confirm the exact base and any sign-on bonus (if offered).

Proposed immediate action: Karthik to confirm: (a) replacement vs net-new, (b) target base to extend verbally (we recommend $120k given market).

Best,
Priya Malhotra
Senior Recruiter, TalentProsourcing
recruits@talentpros.com
